title: Tumour cells shape their environment to protect them from the immune system
title_zh: 肿瘤细胞塑造其环境以躲避免疫系统
abstract: Pancreatic cancer cells use the clotting system to locally educate and retain macrophages and form a protective niche for expansion.
abstract_zh: 胰腺癌细胞利用凝血系统在局部诱导并保留巨噬细胞，形成保护性微环境以促进其扩张。
snippet: Pancreatic cancer cells use the clotting system to locally educate and retain macrophages and form a protective niche for expansion.
